title: TreeDelete
description: TreeDelete is a paper plugin made to remove trees immidietly and efficientiely.
body:
# Description

TreeDelete is a paper plugin that removes trees with ease.

# Commands:

- **/treedel on** – Enable tree decapitation
- **/treedel off – Disable tree decapitation**
- **/treedel combination on|off – Toggle linked tree removal**
- **/treedel items true|false – Toggle item drops**
- **/treedel confirm – Confirm breaking >100 blocks**

# FAQ
I am getting this message.
- You're about to break over 100 blocks. Type /treedel confirm to continue.
- Solution: Use **/treedel confirm**
- **_WARNING: This feature is to prevent accidental major destruction. May cause momentarly lag._**
